newsitem.title: USA: ABC ORDERS LAYOFF OF 200 IN BUDGET CUT - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: ABC ORDERS LAYOFF OF 200 IN BUDGET CUT - WSJ.

text.p: ABC Television ordered layoffs of about 200 workers - or less than 4.0 percent of its 5,000-member workforce - as it prepares to submit its annual budget to parent company Walt Disney Co, the New York Times reported, citing unnamed ABC executives.
Most of the layoffs came through voluntary acceptances of severance packages, although as many as 50 people were fired, the executives told the paper.
The cutbacks were made throughout ABC and affected virtually every department there, said a spokeswoman for ABC.
ABC executives said the network had taken the step on its own without pressure from Disney. They also said the layoffs would be the last at the network for at least a year, the paper reported.
